    Make a printable mandala in four steps

    1. Pick a look. Start from a design above, choose a detail level and press Surprise me, or draw your own.
    2. Set the detail. Fewer slices and thicker lines make it easier to color. More slices and thinner lines make it intricate.
    3. Download the PDF. Choose US Letter or A4. Coloring page keeps it black lines on white.
    4. Print and color. Print at 100 percent scale on plain or heavier paper.

    Printing tips

    • Heavier paper, around 28 lb or 100 gsm and up, takes markers without bleeding through.
    • For digital coloring apps, download a PNG instead, under Other formats.
    • Coloring with a group? Use the share link so everyone opens the same design.

    Or print one that's ready now from the free mandala coloring pages.

    Questions

    How do I make a coloring page?

    Pick a starting design or press Surprise me, change it if you like, then under Get your coloring page choose Letter or A4 and download the PDF. It prints with black lines on white, centered on the page.

    How do I make it easier or harder to color?

    For kids, use 6 or 8 slices, a thick line weight and a few big shapes. For adults, use 16 or more slices, a thin line, and Intricate next to Surprise me.

    Can I print copies for my class?

    Yes. Print as many copies as you like for your classroom, group or family.
